object_summary.note: Old base-contact-ring proxy and 28 separate cap-rib objects removed by Pass 2 payload. Object table_count=34 reflects deleted history; live_object_count=5.

measurements.note: All dimensions in millimeters. Volumes from Rhino computed properties.

per_object.name: Zestly PET Bottle Body
per_object.note: Body now extends from Z=-39mm (base of push-up dome) to Z=196mm. Push-up dome is the new base geometry replacing the flat base ring proxy.

per_object.name: Zestly Neck Finish
per_object.note: Neck outer diameter reduced from 29.6mm (Pass 1) to 28.4mm. Height reduced from 9mm to 7mm. Top of neck (Z=203) is 0mm below cap base (Z=203) — flush seating.

per_object.name: Zestly Printed Label Sleeve
per_object.note: Open surface (by design). Outer radius 33.17mm vs body label-zone radius 33.20mm = 0.03mm radial gap. Essentially conformant (reduced from 0.19mm in Pass 1).

per_object.name: Zestly Screw Cap
per_object.note: 145 faces / 345 edges / 230 vertices. Integrated grip ribs are now part of one solid (was 28 separate rib objects + cap in Pass 1). Outer diameter 36.3mm. Cap volume reduced from 15157mm³ to 5813mm³, indicating hollow interior cavity.

per_object.name: Zestly Tamper Ring
per_object.note: Volume reduced from 3044mm³ to 789mm³. Height 3.0mm, outer radius 17.4mm. Annular form now clears the neck (confirmed: 0 intersections with neck or body in assembly check).

phase21_discrepancy_resolution.D3_tamper_ring_overlaps: RESOLVED — 0mm³ intersection with neck, body, or cap
phase21_discrepancy_resolution.D4_neck_body_overlap: RESOLVED — 0mm³ intersection between neck and body
phase21_discrepancy_resolution.D5_rib_cap_intersections: RESOLVED — ribs are now integrated into cap solid, no separate rib objects
phase21_discrepancy_resolution.D6_metadata_incomplete: RESOLVED — all 5 objects have complete revision/parent lineage metadata

label_sleeve_material.note: Material retained from Pass 1. 184-degree rotation was applied by payload. Which label face is centered in Front view requires visual controller review of rendered-front capture.

objective_discrepancies.description: Label sleeve outer radius (33.17mm) is approximately 0.03mm inside the body surface at the label zone (body label-zone radius reported as 33.20mm). Sleeve is conformant to within 0.03mm — significantly improved from the 0.19mm gap in Pass 1. The minor inset may be acceptable for rendering; physical accuracy would require exact conformance.
objective_discrepancies.observed: Label outer radius=33.17mm, body label-zone radius=33.20mm, inset=0.03mm
objective_discrepancies.expected: Label sleeve conformant to or just outside body surface

objective_discrepancies.description: Body now extends to Z=-39mm (push-up dome depth). The bottle's standing plane is determined by the perimeter contact edge of the push-up dome rather than Z=0. Exact standing-plane Z and contact-ring diameter are not directly accessible from bounding box alone; a bottom orthographic capture and push-up geometry inspection would clarify. The push-up dome feature is present and visible from the body bbox extending to Z=-39.
objective_discrepancies.observed: Body bbox Z_min=-39.0mm. Assembly total span=258.5mm. Above-Z0 height=219.5mm.
objective_discrepancies.expected: Standing height ~220-240mm for 500ml PET; push-up dome typically 8-15mm deep, not 39mm

objective_discrepancies.description: Label face orientation after 184-degree mapping correction cannot be confirmed from geometric measurements alone. The front rendered capture must be reviewed visually to determine whether the Zestly green hero panel is now centered in the front (Y-negative) view. Measurement evidence is inconclusive on this point.
objective_discrepancies.observed: Texture mapping rotation applied by payload (184 degrees per controller spec). Which panel faces Y-negative is not measurable via MCP.
objective_discrepancies.expected: Zestly green hero panel centered in front rendered view

objective_discrepancies.description: Cap outer diameter is 36.3mm (18.15mm radius), which is wider than the neck finish outer diameter (28.4mm). The cap sits above the neck from Z=203–219.5mm. Tamper ring outer radius is 17.4mm, cap outer radius 18.15mm — cap slightly wider than tamper ring as expected. No intersection detected between cap and neck (0mm³), confirming clearance. Cap diameter increase from Pass 1 (34.2mm) is noted.
objective_discrepancies.observed: Cap outer diameter=36.3mm, neck outer diameter=28.4mm, tamper ring outer diameter=34.8mm
objective_discrepancies.expected: Cap should clear neck with appropriate seating geometry; measured clearance confirmed
